name: Fleet Management
description: Real-time GPS transponder tracking, live vehicle map with live alerts, day-to-day route schedule and ETAs, geofence boundaries, and overspeed or offline alerting with isolated configuration.
description_zh: 实时 GPS 应答器定位追踪、集成实时告警的在线车辆地图、按日路线调度与预计到达时间（ETA）、电子围栏以及超速/离线告警，配置独立隔离。
